recomputed: All 36 entries in SOURCES.tsv matched both SHA-256 and size (11,647,321 bytes total). I parsed the structured responses, opened the four PDFs, inspected the HTML contents and decompressed the matrix, SOFT and every TAR member. Fresh downloads of the GEO SOFT, GEO TAR and PMC supplement matched the retained bytes. The PMC and BioStudies inventories list the same two supplemental PDFs. Figure S9 shows GO terms. The first author’s thesis (ORBi 2268/314876, appendix Figures E.8–E.9) also shows F1 enrichment and targeted qPCR. The five ledgers contain a processed-source manual review and an untested verification record, with no dataset-specific comparability record, comparison spec or concordance review. The registry, sample sheet and SOFT identify female Wistar P21 MBH-PoA, edc_vs_vehicle, GSM5129961–64 vehicle and GSM5129965–68 EDC. All eight registered libraries are L002. All 16 deposited files (8 F1, 8 F3) have four STAR summary rows and the same 32,883 distinct rat Ensembl IDs with three integer count columns. The series matrix has 16 sample columns and zero gene rows. Tables S3 and S5 give control means of 1 and EDC means of 0.18, 0.33, 3.41, 0.26, 0.89 and 1.06 for Th, Dnm1, Drd1, Darpp32, Nr3c1 and Crh, respectively. Reported qPCR P values in that order are 0.031, 0.039, 0.016, 0.095, 0.41 and 0.82. Rat Gene 360616 and Table S1’s RefSeq NM_138521.1 identify Darpp32 as Ppp1r1b. All six map uniquely. All six have nonzero effects. Four signs agree, with Drd1 and Crh opposite. Pearson = 0.599704945, Spearman = 0.485714286, median absolute log2 difference = 1.135645839 and maximum = 1.961588136. The qPCR panel covers 6/6 selected targets and 6/12,911 published genes (0.046472%). Aggregating the deposited count column by the registered feature map and replaying the expression filter recovered all 12,911 published symbols plus 1,676 unmapped rows, for 14,587 tested. Three qPCR P values and five registered BH values fall below 0.05. Of 6,864 published BH calls, 6,859 fall outside the panel. The DE file SHA-256 is 16c67ba8aec24efd8b2bf1b02826506ec4fdabdd25dd4d3c6586fcac6d7d966b. The six targets are the complete P21 F1 mRNA panels in Figures 6A and S10A. No significance cutoff or sign reversal selected the pairs. The existing ledger enums support a limited selected-results comparison with no fully verified contrast. Six pairs, 4/6 sign agreement and the two correlations fall below author-concordance-v2 thresholds.
problems: The manifest and search log misidentify geo/series.html as the GEO series record. Its 21,481 bytes have SHA-256 01bb7b47f6b6b51aa3ca5e8bc8f6bf5b20f3a275abcc7ede4761d2dc6dad695f and the title “Checking your browser - reCAPTCHA”. The corrected proposal relies on the checksum-matched family SOFT and TAR, plus the series matrix. The separately labeled Europe PMC export XML is a connection-refused response.

The original note says several genes increased or decreased without distinguishing a difference in group means from an inferential call. Drd1 has qPCR P = 0.016 and registered BH = 0.636. Crh has qPCR P = 0.82 and registered BH = 0.0124. The two opposite signs are descriptive. The 6,864 BH calls count published symbols only.

The magnitudes have different reference scales. The published qPCR means use β-actin and the control mean, and registered Actb has log2FC +0.734170 (BH 0.00002146). Its RNA-seq coefficient cannot establish β-actin stability in the qPCR animals. The paper also describes TopHat2/featureCounts, whereas the deposited count files use STAR ReadsPerGene format. These limitations belong in any assessment of cross-assay effects or reproduction of the original RNA-seq fit.

The original criteria omit the correlation and directional agreement cutoffs. The corrected criteria identify both numerical routes and distinguish full coverage of the six selected targets from 0.046472% coverage of the registered output.
